visual_style: An inspired interpretation of Warp's design language — an agentic terminal-and-development-environment brand whose surface is a warm near-charcoal canvas (a tint warmer than pure black), broken only by clean Inter typography, the occasional Instrument Serif italic moment, and dense terminal-mockup imagery; CTAs are unusually understated, with shape geometry running tighter than most marketing sites.
